q1_issues.issue: The age measure invents the scale symbol `age`; the instruction set's age form is `(Measure <person> old <n> year)` and a scale no word supplies must be the reserved `unspecified`, so a stored `age` scale matches no licensed question.

q2_gaps: a time modifier on a measure predication ("was 26 then") — a copular clause with a time modifier reifies its state to anchor the time, but a `Measure` atom has no event slot and no reification route is given, and bare anaphoric "then" has no antecedent for term propagation, so it is dropped entirely
contrastive "another" ("another position") — distinctness from an already-mentioned entity has no licensed carrier
"former" as a temporal/rank adjective on a predicate nominal — nothing says whether to fuse (`former_manager` + genus `manager`) or to wrap the typing atom in `Past` as here
notes: Factive projection of the "knew" complement, the reified `unhappy` state with its `In` complement plus flat dual-emit, and the tipping roles all follow doctrine. The witness stem `sk_person_1` for "a friend and former manager" departs from the mint-from-class convention, though no unstated type atom is asserted.
